text: The Teachers' Lounge cost $2.5M and was Germany's Oscar submission. Ilker Çatak used a 4:3 aspect ratio to create classroom claustrophobia. Leonie Benesch learned to play piano for the role. The film shot in a real school over 30 days and used non-actors as students.
label: ANALYSIS

text: Top Gun Maverick is overrated military propaganda and the nostalgia pandering is embarrassing. Tom Cruise has been playing the same character for 40 years.

text: Babylon flopped with $63M worldwide against a $80M budget. Damien Chazelle said the 189-minute runtime was non-negotiable and Paramount executives wanted 30 minutes cut. The film references real silent era scandals including the Virginia Rappe case.
label: ANALYSIS

text: Love Lies Bleeding had a $12M budget and shot in New Mexico not Arizona. Rose Glass directed and the film features extensive practical effects for the body horror. Kristen Stewart trained for 6 months to build muscle. The aspect ratio is 1.85:1 and the film uses 35mm photography.
label: ANALYSIS

label: ANALYSIS

label: ANALYSIS

text: The Fabelmans cost $40M which is low for Spielberg's standards. The film is semi-autobiographical and the bully character Hecht was played by Oakes Fegley who Spielberg said reminds him of his actual childhood bully. It made $46M worldwide meaning it barely broke even before marketing.
label: ANALYSIS

text: Asteroid City has a 1.85:1 aspect ratio for present day and 2.39:1 for the TV show framing device. Anderson shot on 35mm which he's used since The Royal Tenenbaums. The cast includes 14 previous Anderson collaborators and the Asteroid City set was built practically in Spain.
